classes.name: Warrior
classes.description: Unmatched endurance and defense. Holds the line with taunts and disciplines.

classes.name: Paladin
classes.description: Armored champion of faith. Stuns, heals, and smites the undead.

classes.name: Shadow Knight
classes.description: Dark armored knight who steals life, spreads fear, and commands the dead.

classes.name: Ranger
classes.description: Bow-wielding warden of the wilds with snares, tracking, and nature magic.

classes.name: Bard
classes.description: Wandering musician whose songs haste allies, soothe foes, and speed the road.

classes.name: Rogue
classes.description: Strikes from the shadows with backstabs, poisons, and quick escapes.

classes.name: Monk
classes.description: Unarmed master of speed and avoidance who can feign death.

classes.name: Cleric
classes.description: The finest healer, bringer of resurrection and holy wards.

classes.name: Druid
classes.description: Nature's caller: healing over time, roots, thorns, and swift portals.

classes.name: Shaman
classes.description: Spirit-speaker who slows enemies and strengthens allies.

classes.name: Wizard
classes.description: Master of raw destructive magic and long-distance teleportation.

classes.name: Magician
classes.description: Summoner of elemental servants and conjured gear.

classes.name: Necromancer
classes.description: Wields decay and drain, raising the dead to serve.

classes.name: Enchanter
classes.description: Bends minds: mesmerizes, charms, and quickens allies.
